name: How do I choose the right contractor for my granny flat project in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my granny flat project in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for your granny flat project in Las Vegas, look for one with experience in ADU construction and a strong understanding of local zoning and building codes. Verify their licensing and insurance, check references, and review their portfolio of similar projects. A good contractor should offer transparent pricing, clear communication, and a detailed project plan. Obtain multiple bids and ensure the contractor provides a written contract outlining all aspects of the project, including timelines and payment schedules.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with ADU experience, local code knowledge, proper licensing, good references, and transparent communication for your Las Vegas project.
